senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. Lebanon, the mountain range in the north of Palestine.
units: Cant. R. to IV, 15 עד שתהא … כמין ל׳ until the decision (Halachah) sprouts forth (bright) like a kind of Lebanon; ib. V, 12 (cmp. לִבְלֵב); a. fr.—Metaph. King; Temple.
